issues.detail: The Hebrew 'וְכָל הָעֶרֶב' (and all the mixed multitude/foreigners) is rendered as '一切阿拉伯人' (all Arabs), which is a mistranslation. 'הָעֶרֶב' means 'the mixed multitude' or 'the mingled people', not 'Arabs'.
The Hebrew 'וְכוּב' (and Cub) is rendered as '丘壟' (mounds/hills), which is a mistranslation. 'כוּב' is a proper name (Cub, likely a place/people), not a common noun meaning 'mound'.
